notes: Seven web searches ran; none were refused. No search returned a statement by Rep. Linda T. Sánchez about AI. Results for 'Sánchez' and AI safety, superintelligence or China were about Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, a different person, and were left out. The site-restricted search returned no lindasanchez.house.gov pages. I opened the first two pages of her press releases (9 June to 29 October 2026, 20 releases); none of the titles mention AI (topics were trade, tariffs, Social Security, immigration, the film industry, critical minerals). Earlier pages were not checked, and the lindasanchez.house.gov search page returned 403 Forbidden, so the review of her official site is incomplete. The 2 September 2026 hearing opening statement on critical resources and supply chains and the 17 August 2026 critical minerals letter were not opened; their titles do not suggest AI content. No source showed her as a sponsor or co-sponsor of the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act; the congress.gov search page returned 403, so the co-sponsor list was not checked directly. A min.house.gov article on lawmakers discussing AI fears was opened and does not mention her.
